label: Bible Study
prompt: But above all things, my brethren, _____ not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verse: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
note: James echoes the Sermon on the Mount — let your yes mean yes.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in _____ there shall no evil touch thee.
verse: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
note: Six troubles, seven — however many come, Eliphaz says, no evil shall touch thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there were in the same country shepherds _____ in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verse: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
note: The first Christmas announcement went to night-shift shepherds, abiding in the field with their flock.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Being justified _____ by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verse: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
note: 'Freely' is the same Greek word Jesus uses for being hated 'without a cause' — grace with no reason in us.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and _____ as doves.
verse: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
note: Jesus' briefing before sending out the Twelve: wise as serpents, and 'harmless' as doves — innocent of any guile.
